had a long time to prepare as well, and they are  really good at what they do. But I've been really

Ben White, Martin Ødegaard and Bukayo Saka coming  together, producing goals. Yeah, we missed them

So it was good. It was about the connection  between players. What I really liked was the

individual performances, and that's something that  [inaudible]. At this level, I think the players  
have to be decisive, and they were certainly  decisive today. I think Kai, Bukayo and Martin,  
who all scored, it was only their second start  together in the Premier League since December  
2024, which shows you how little you've had them.  We talk about transfers a lot, but having the  
players that already exist available must be so  key to you. And the main focus has to be that,  
to improve our players and improve the connection  between them, because they are already so good.  
And, yeah, when we talk about the attacking input,  last season we missed some of those players for a  
lot of months, you know, and the team still had  the ability to perform and win a lot of matches.  
And when we have them there, that's a bonus. Hi,  Mikel. Did you sense a different feeling in your  
group when you came here as champions compared  to last year, with all that stress and all that  
desire? They keep asking me. They look exactly  the same to me, inside each player. I don't know  
what's going on, but what they transmit is more  desire and more will to improve, to be better and  
to earn the right to be better than anybody else.  And that's what we want to do. Do you think they  
looked a bit relaxed? I don't like the word. They  can flow, but relaxed, no. I think they need to be  
at the right level of clarity. They know how to  do it, they know what they have to do. They look  
really connected and they play with a lot of  purpose, which I really like. Christos Tzolis  
seemed to make such an impression today. Fans  are already comparing him to [inaudible]. I can  
see that. I can see the comparison. Well, I love  that a player who has been with us for just a few  
weeks gets this kind of energy every time he's on  the ball. I think he's earned it. I think the way  
he has performed in the last few games has been  phenomenal. What he transmits as a player, so  
direct, so incisive, constantly he wants to make  things happen, and he has an incredible variety of  
actions in the last 30 metres to [inaudible] and  to make the right decisions, even when the spaces  
are sometimes really, really small. So very, very,  very happy with him. Last season, at times there  
was nervous energy from the fans in the stadium,  but tonight you've worked hard on unlocking that  
from the fans. Did you feel a different type of  energy in the stadium tonight? Let's see when we  
are nil-nil and when we are maybe losing a game,  and see how we react. Today was the start of the  
game and the two goals were obviously a good  platform for everybody to feel this way. But  
I think we all learned from the past as well,  and what really helps the team. Certainly,  
this kind of atmosphere in the stadium is  just a joy to witness and to play football  
in. It seems that the only bad news this week has  been Bruno Guimarães' injury. How long? There are  
some suggestions he might be out for six weeks  or seven weeks. No, no, no, no. We expect that  
not to be weeks at all. Let's see how he evolves  this week. He didn't even want to stop. I mean,  
he wanted to carry on, and we start to understand  the character of the player. But I don't expect  
that to be a big issue. You brought in Ezri Konsa  and paraded him on the pitch. Now you've got such  
a strong squad. Is that quite an ominous warning  to the rest of the Premier League that you've got  
such a strong squad? No, because when I look at  their squads, they have such incredible squads  
as well, and some of them are still much bigger  than ours. So we just look to improve and to do  
what we believe is right for us, understanding  the players that we already have and the players  
who can give us an edge and improve us. Ezri  is certainly a player, because we are really,  
really light in the defensive line and that was a  massive risk to take. Hi, Mikel. Congratulations  
on today's victory. When you see your team play  like this and produce this kind of performance,  
do you feel that Arsenal still need to sign  a striker, like Julián Álvarez, for example?  
As I said, I'm really happy with the squad that  we have, and the main focus is to improve the  
players that we already have, because  we already have a lot of good things.
